summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Material Fact to Chile's CMF: on August 19, 2026, it issued a USD 15 million bond under its EMTN Programme, settling August 26, 2026, maturing August 26, 2031, at SOFR plus 90 basis points. The filing, signed by CFO Patricia Pérez Pallacán, is a routine debt-issuance notice, not a special situation; no equity, board recommendation, advisor, premium, or change of control is involved. Watch ordinary funding-cost and rollover dynamics rather than event-driven arbitrage.
